title: On a conjecture of DeLaViña and Waller
summary: The Wiener index of a connected graph is defined as the sum of distances between all its unordered pairs of vertices. Characterising graphs on $n$ vertices with a fixed diameter that maximise the Wiener index is a long-standing open problem. This problem has been resolved fully for trees on $n$ vertices with diameter $d \in \{1,2,3,4,n-3,n-2,n-1\}$ while partial results are available for $d=5$ and $6$.
